LEFT.meta: [LEFT]: EITHER Type (Church Encoded) | LEFT x  = λl.λr.l x RIGHT y = λl.λr.r y

MAYBE_CASE.meta: [MAYBE_CASE]: MAYBE_CASE: Access internal value of Maybe

B0.meta: [B0]: BIT: A functional unit of binary state.

BYTE.meta: [BYTE]: BYTE: Construct an 8-bit word as a recursive CONS structure.

S_MAP.meta: [S_MAP]: S_MAP: Lazy Map over a stream

S_TAIL.meta: [S_TAIL]: S_TAIL: Access tail of stream (evaluates the thunk)

STREAM.meta: [STREAM]: STREAM: Construct a Lazy Stream (Pair where CDR is a Thunk) | STREAM x f = CONS x (λ_.f)

FILTER.meta: [FILTER]: FILTER: Select elements from l satisfying p | FILTER = Y (λr.λp.λl. IS_NIL l NIL (p (CAR l) (CONS (CAR l) (r p (CDR l))) (r p (CDR l))))

FOLD.meta: [FOLD]: FOLD (Right): Accumulate l using f starting with init | FOLD = Y (λr.λf.λinit.λl. IS_NIL l init (f (CAR l) (r f init (CDR l))))

MAP.meta: [MAP]: MAP: Apply f to each element of list l | MAP = Y (λr.λf.λl. IS_NIL l NIL (CONS (f (CAR l)) (r f (CDR l))))

TRIPLE.meta: [TRIPLE]: TRIPLE: Construct a 3-tuple | TRIPLE x y z = λs.s x y z

MULT.meta: [MULT]: Multiplication: MULT m n = λm.λn.λf. m (n f)

POW.meta: [POW]: Exponentiation: POW b e = λb.λe. e b

CONS.meta: [CONS]: CONS: Construct Pair | CONS x y = λs.s x y

IS_NIL.meta: [IS_NIL]: IS_NIL: Checks if a list is empty

NIL.meta: [NIL]: Nil / Empty List: (Equivalent to F or λx.T)

EQ.meta: [EQ]: Equality: EQ m n = AND (LEQ m n) (LEQ n m)

LEQ.meta: [LEQ]: Less than or Equal: LEQ m n = IS_ZERO (SUB m n)

PRED.meta: [PRED]: Predecessor Function: PRED n | PRED n = λn.λf.λx. n (λg.λh. h (g f)) (λu.x) (λu.u)

SUB.meta: [SUB]: Subtraction: SUB m n = n PRED m

IS_ZERO.meta: [IS_ZERO]: IS_ZERO: Returns T if n is N0, else F. | IS_ZERO n = n (λx.F) T

ADD.meta: [ADD]: Addition: ADD m n = λm.λn.λf.λx.m f (n f x)

N0.meta: [N0]: Church Numeral: ZERO (λf.λx.x) | Equivalent to False (F) or (λx.I)

SUCC.meta: [SUCC]: Successor Function: SUCC n = λn.λf.λx.f (n f x)

AND.meta: [AND]: Logical AND: AND p q = p q p

F.meta: [F]: Church Boolean: FALSE (The Selector of the Second) | F = λx.λy.y (equivalent to KI)

NOT.meta: [NOT]: Logical NOT: NOT p = p F T

OR.meta: [OR]: Logical OR: OR p q = p p q

T.meta: [T]: Church Boolean: TRUE (The Selector of the First) | T = λx.λy.x (equivalent to K)
